questions.prompt: Return date and yield_percent for the 10-year maturity on the first five available dates in 2023. Sort by date from earliest to latest.
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT date, yield_percent
FROM yields
WHERE maturity_years = 10 AND date < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 5;

questions.prompt: Find the dates when the 10-year yield was at least 4.5%. Return date and yield_percent, sorted by yield descending and then date ascending.
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT date, yield_percent
FROM yields
WHERE maturity_years = 10 AND yield_percent >= 4.5
ORDER BY yield_percent DESC, date;

questions.prompt: Calculate the average yield for each maturity across all sample dates. Return maturity_years and average_yield rounded to three decimal places, ordered by maturity.
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT maturity_years, ROUND(AVG(yield_percent), 3) AS average_yield
FROM yields
GROUP BY maturity_years
ORDER BY maturity_years;

questions.prompt: Join yields with maturities to show name, date and yield_percent for January 2, 2025. Order the rows by the number of years to maturity.
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT m.name, y.date, y.yield_percent
FROM yields AS y
JOIN maturities AS m ON y.maturity_years = m.years
WHERE y.date = '2025-01-02'
ORDER BY m.years;

questions.prompt: Find dates when the 10-year yield was below the 2-year yield. Return date and the 10-year-minus-2-year spread as spread_pp, rounded to four decimal places. Sort by date.
questions.reference_sql:
SELECT ten.date,
       ROUND(ten.yield_percent - two.yield_percent, 4) AS spread_pp
FROM yields AS ten
JOIN yields AS two ON ten.date = two.date
WHERE ten.maturity_years = 10 AND two.maturity_years = 2
  AND ten.yield_percent < two.yield_percent
ORDER BY ten.date;
